step_description: Businesses lose time and money because procurement data is fragmented across search, compliance, pricing, and bid decision workflows.
Demonstrate semantic search and graph-backed Q&A as the entry point.
Show bid readiness, complexity, risk flags, and opportunity-level recommendations.
Walk through capture, supplier, compliance, pricing, proposal, and executive decision logic.
Show the partner_or_restructure recommendation as proof that the system is risk-aware, not blindly optimistic.
Position the platform as decision intelligence for procurement teams, suppliers, advisors, and bid leaders.
